problem_statement: Build a brand-new /uses page from scratch on the Astro Cactus site. The route /uses does not exist yet (baseline is empty/404). Construct a full 'What I Use' page that lists the gear and software the author relies on, grouped into three categories: Editor (Neovim, VS Code, Zed), Terminal (WezTerm, Starship, fish shell) and Hardware (MacBook Pro 14, Keychron K2, LG UltraFine). The page MUST reuse the site's shared layout (the Base.astro PageLayout that renders the BaseHead, Header nav and Footer) so it matches the header/nav/footer and theme tokens used by the existing index and about pages. Add a category-filter interaction: three filter buttons (Editor, Terminal, Hardware) that toggle which tool cards are visible; the Editor group is shown by default and clicking a button reveals that category's cards while hiding the others. The page must be mobile-clean (no horizontal overflow at 390px).
required_content: An intro paragraph starting 'A living list of the gear and software I lean on daily' explaining the page and inviting the reader to filter
A filter control group with three <button> elements labelled 'Editor', 'Terminal' and 'Hardware', each carrying a unique data-uses-filter attribute (editor/terminal/hardware)

Nine tool cards (three per category) inlined as static page data; each card is an
containing an

tool name and a

note

Editor cards (Neovim, VS Code, Zed) visible by default; Terminal cards (WezTerm, Starship, fish shell) and Hardware cards (MacBook Pro 14, Keychron K2, LG UltraFine) hidden until their filter is clicked
The shared site chrome: Header nav links (Home / About / Blog / Notes) and Footer, inherited by wrapping the page in the Base.astro PageLayout
A client-side script that wires the filter buttons to show only the clicked category's cards
design_constraints: Wrap the page in @/layouts/Base.astro (PageLayout) so it reuses BaseHead + Header + Footer + global.css theme tokens — same shared chrome as index.astro and about.astro (cross-page consistency)
Reuse the theme's Tailwind utility classes and the .title / cactus-link / text-accent / text-muted design tokens
Filter buttons must be selectable by a unique data-uses-filter attribute (not by shell-chrome text)
No horizontal overflow on the 390px mobile viewport
author_notes: 方案A: baseline src/pages/uses.astro = bare empty stub (no layout) so the SSG build still emits dist/uses/index.html but renders no content (check A). reference = full page wrapped in Base.astro PageLayout with the Editor/Terminal/Hardware filter interaction. bad = same content + working interaction but rendered WITHOUT the shared BaseLayout (its own bare , no Header nav / Footer) -> cross-page consistency FAILS (nav-link dom_assertions on Blog/Notes miss) while dom content + interaction still pass. Exactly ONE target gate fails. Three workspace src trees md5-distinct.
